inputs.text: Photorealistic local inpainting. Repair only the masked front-view waist and top-hem layer boundary.  Goal: Make the blouse hem and waist layering look more like the outfit references: the ivory blouse should sit over the skirt with a soft shaped hem/peplum effect. The brown belt should not dominate the front view. It may remain only as a subtle partial waist detail if needed for natural structure.  Preserve: - face, hair, glasses, skin tone, body shape, body pose, and hands; - skirt length, skirt silhouette, and front slit; - footwear and earrings; - side-view figure; - background, floor, door, wall, and camera framing; - all unmasked regions except natural edge blending at the mask boundary.  Do not: - redesign the outfit; - change the person; - change the body outline; - change the blouse sleeves, neckline, or buttons outside the mask; - invent a new belt, buckle, bag, jewelry, or extra garment; - edit outside the mask.  Pass condition: The masked waist/layer boundary is improved and the rest of the image remains visually unchanged.
